notes.title: Disjoint is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32518740/f3c5ab7d23303bae36b962625337f191d005a438.png[/img]

 [h1]                                                    - - - We are Live!  - - - [/h1]

It's been a long road (longer than we thought!) but [b]Disjoint[/b] is now available for download on Steam.  

We started [b]Disjoint[/b] as a side project over 3.5 years ago as three friends with a bit of a wacky puzzle idea and not a lot of experience.   After years of hard work we feel we've produced a game we're really proud of.  We released on mobile back in November to rave reviews but didn't want to stop there.  We are extremely excited that we can now share it with the Steam community!

Join a cast of fun characters on a puzzle adventure across 9 chapters with 144 puzzles to test your skill!
